earnings.title: Pfizer Reports Strong Third-Quarter 2026 Results And Raises 2026 Guidance
highlights: Revenues of Launched and Acquired Products (1) Grew 32% Operationally
Excluding Contributions from Comirnaty and Paxlovid, Revenues Grew 7% Operationally
outlook: An anticipated unfavorable revenue impact of approximately $1.1 billion due to recent and expected generic and biosimilar competition for certain products that have recently lost patent or regulatory protection or that are anticipated to lose patent or regulatory protection.
Guidance for Adjusted (3) diluted EPS assumes diluted weighted-average shares outstanding of approximately 5.74 billion shares, and assumes no share repurchases in 2026.
